definitions.explanation: Doing something well but taking too long. Met almost only in the saying {拙速|せっそく}は{巧遅|こうち}に{勝|まさ}る.

examples.japanese: ⟦{拙速|せっそく}→拙速：09061_sessoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{巧遅|こうち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|まさ}る→勝る：11848_masaru⟧。
examples.english: Quick and rough beats skilled but slow.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{巧遅|こうち}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{拙速|せっそく}→拙速：09061_sessoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んだ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: This time we chose speed over polish.

examples.japanese: {巧遅|こうち}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{避|さ}ける→避ける：02109_sakeru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧⟦{試作品|しさくひん}→試作品：22445_shisakuhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}して→出す：01087_dasu⟧⟦{反応|はんのう}を{見|み}る→反応を見る：17508_hannouwomiru⟧ことにした。
examples.english: To avoid being perfect but late, we decided to release a prototype first and see the response.

notes:
COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{拙速|せっそく}→拙速：09061_sessoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{巧遅|こうち}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|まさ}る→勝る：11848_masaru⟧: quick and rough beats skilled but slow; traced to Sun Tzu, close to "done is better than perfect"
- {巧遅|こうち}⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{拙速|せっそく}→拙速：09061_sessoku⟧: speed over polish

USAGE:
- A written word, found almost only as the counterpart of ⟦{拙速|せっそく}→拙速：09061_sessoku⟧ in this saying and its variations.
